preconditions.expression: T == int(stdin.split()[0]) and T >= 1 and T <= 10
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 10) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and 1 <= int(x) <= N and 1 <= int(y) <= N and int(x) != int(y) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:1+M] if line.strip())
preconditions.description: For each test case, the next M lines contain pairs of integers (x, y) where 1 ≤ x, y ≤ N, x ≠ y, representing undirected main roads (edges) between nodes x and y. No self-loops or duplicate edges exist.

preconditions.expression: N == int(stdin.split()[1]) and N >= 2 and N <= 200000 and M >= 0 and M <= 120000
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line contains integers N (2 ≤ N ≤ 2×10^5) and M (0 ≤ M ≤ 120000), where N is the number of nodes and M is the number of main roads.
The last line of each test case contains an integer S (1 ≤ S ≤ N), representing Rust's starting node.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(node) <= N for node in range(1, N+1))
preconditions.description: All nodes are labeled from 1 to N, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line.split()) == N-1 for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output line contains exactly N-1 space-separated integers, representing the shortest distances from node S to all other nodes (1 to N except S) using village roads (non-edges in the main road graph).
Each distance in the output is a non-negative integer, representing the number of village roads in the shortest path from S to the corresponding node.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_line.split()[i-1]) == min(sum(1 for _ in path) for path in all_paths) if (i != S) else True for i in range(1, N+1) for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip())
postconditions.description: For each node i ≠ S, the output distance is the minimum number of village roads (non-edges in the main road graph) in any path from S to i. A village road exists between two nodes if there is no main road between them.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_line.split()[i-1]) == 0 if i == S else True for i in range(1, N+1) for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip())
postconditions.description: The distance from S to itself is implicitly excluded from the output (as per the problem statement).

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_line.split()[i-1]) == int(output_line.split()[j-1]) if (i != S and j != S and i != j) else True for i in range(1, N+1) for j in range(1, N+1) for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip() and i != j)
postconditions.description: The output distances are ordered such that the distance for node i appears at position i-1 in the output line (1-based to 0-based index).
